about: The code examples of the chapter 20 deck, in the order of the code slides (order = slide order). Every example is self-contained and runs offline, reads no keyboard and opens no window. Google's service is replaced by unittest.mock.MagicMock (ezgmail.SERVICE_GMAIL), the mail server by a local aiosmtpd server (plain and with STARTTLS, using a one-day certificate made by openssl), and the ntfy server by a local http.server recorder; the slide says so (EMULATED). The ntfy answer of the polling example and the weather forecast of the umbrella example are typed in, so that the run never changes. No example needs an account. The expected result is what the run printed under Python 3.13.18. The code is exactly the text of the deck's code boxes with the '>>> ' prompt removed.

executed_with.library: ezgmail, requests, aiosmtpd (installed with pip), and the standard library

page_requirements: the packages ezgmail, requests and aiosmtpd, and the standard library modules email, smtplib, ssl, subprocess, http.server, threading, hmac, secrets, json, datetime, html.parser

on the page (Pyodide) there are no sockets, threads or subprocesses: the examples that start a server, a thread or the openssl command are shown as recorded results, and the chapter-code tab says which

examples.name: Sending mail with EZGmail
examples.code:
import ezgmail, base64, email
from unittest.mock import MagicMock
ezgmail.SERVICE_GMAIL = MagicMock()
ezgmail.EMAIL_ADDRESS = 'me@example.com'
ezgmail.send('al@example.org', 'RoboCop', 'Watch it this weekend?')
call = ezgmail.SERVICE_GMAIL.users().messages().send.call_args
raw = call.kwargs['body']['raw']
msg = email.message_from_bytes(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(raw))
print(msg['To'], '|', msg['From'], '|', msg['Subject'])
print(msg.get_payload())

examples.name: smtplib and STARTTLS
examples.code:
import smtplib, ssl, subprocess, tempfile, os
from aiosmtpd.controller import Controller
os.chdir(tempfile.mkdtemp())
cmd = ('openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -subj /CN=localhost'
       ' -addext subjectAltName=DNS:localhost -keyout k.pem -out c.pem')
subprocess.run(cmd.split(), capture_output=True)
ctx = ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER)
ctx.load_cert_chain('c.pem', 'k.pem')
ctl = Controller(object(), port=8025, tls_context=ctx)
ctl.start()
smtp = smtplib.SMTP('localhost', 8025)
print(smtp.ehlo()[0], smtp.has_extn('starttls'))
cli = ssl.create_default_context(cafile='c.pem')
print(smtp.starttls(context=cli)[0])
print(type(smtp.sock).__name__)
ctl.stop()

examples.name: SMTP refusals and errors
examples.code:
from aiosmtpd.controller import Controller
class Box:
    async def handle_RCPT(self, srv, ses, envelope, address, opts):
        if 'refused' in address:
            return '550 no such mailbox'
        envelope.rcpt_tos.append(address)
        return '250 OK'
import smtplib
ctl = Controller(Box(), hostname='127.0.0.1', port=8026)
ctl.start()
smtp = smtplib.SMTP('127.0.0.1', 8026)
to = ['ok@a.example', 'x@refused.example']
print(smtp.sendmail('al@a.example', to, 'hi'))
try:
    smtp.sendmail('al@a.example', to[1:], 'hi')
except smtplib.SMTPRecipientsRefused as e:
    print('all refused:', e.recipients)
ctl.stop()
examples.expected:
{'x@refused.example': (550, b'no such mailbox')}
all refused: {'x@refused.example': (550, b'no such mailbox')}

examples.name: Envelope against headers
examples.code:
from aiosmtpd.controller import Controller
sent = []
class Box:
    async def handle_DATA(self, server, session, envelope):
        sent.append(envelope)
        return '250 OK'
import smtplib
ctl = Controller(Box(), hostname='127.0.0.1', port=8027)
ctl.start()
text = 'From: al@example.com\r\nTo: jon@example.org\r\n\r\nWatch it?'
to = ['jon@example.org', 'boss@example.net']
with smtplib.SMTP('127.0.0.1', 8027) as smtp:
    smtp.sendmail('al@example.com', to, text)
ctl.stop()
print(sent[0].mail_from, sent[0].rcpt_tos)
print('boss in text:', 'boss@example.net' in sent[0].content.decode())

examples.name: ntfy: polling
examples.code:
import json
rows = [{'time': 1797823340, 'event': 'open'},
        {'time': 1797823341, 'event': 'message', 'message': 'Hello!'},
        {'time': 1797823350, 'event': 'message',
         'title': 'Backup', 'message': 'Done'}]
answer = '\n'.join(json.dumps(r) for r in rows)
events = [json.loads(line) for line in answer.splitlines()]
print([e['event'] for e in events])
from datetime import datetime, UTC
for e in events:
    if e['event'] == 'message':
        t = datetime.fromtimestamp(e['time'], UTC).strftime('%H:%M:%S')
        print(t, e.get('title', '-'), e['message'])

examples.name: Topic secrecy and limits
examples.code:
import math, secrets
topic = 'AlSweigartZPgxBQ42'
per, n = math.log2(62), len(topic)
print(n, 'characters:', round(n * per, 1), 'bits at most')
print(round(8 * per, 1), 'bits for a guessable 8-letter name')
random_topic = secrets.token_urlsafe(18)
print(len(random_topic), 'characters; 144 bits of randomness')
title = 'Yedekleme tamamlandı'
print(len(title), 'characters,', len(title.encode()), 'bytes')

47.6 bits for a guessable 8-letter name

examples.name: Umbrella reminder
examples.code:
periods = [{'name': 'Tonight', 'shortForecast': 'Showers Likely',
            'probabilityOfPrecipitation': {'value': 60}},
           {'name': 'Friday', 'shortForecast': 'Mostly Sunny',
            'probabilityOfPrecipitation': {'value': None}}]
for p in periods:
    chance = p['probabilityOfPrecipitation']['value'] or 0
    word = 'rain' in p['shortForecast'].lower()
    row = {'word': word, 'chance': chance, 'umbrella': chance >= 50}
    print(p['name'], row)
examples.expected:
Tonight {'word': False, 'chance': 60, 'umbrella': True}
Friday {'word': False, 'chance': 0, 'umbrella': False}
